fields.schemeName: Shri Varun Panwar Memorial Award for B.Sc. Agriculture (2nd Year, 3rd Year, and 4th Year) Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage B.Sc. Agriculture students in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of study by awarding them a cash prize of ₹10,000/- for their academic excellence.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹700/- per month to parents or guardians for the care of children below 18 years of age with more than 40% disability.

fields.schemeName: Training Programme for Sugarcane Farmers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the knowledge and skills of sugarcane farmers by providing free training and information on advanced and modern sugarcane cultivation techniques.

fields.schemeName: Appointment of Contract Sports Coaches
fields.briefDescription: The scheme facilitates the annual appointment of contract-based sports coaches to conduct various local training camps across Uttarakhand, thereby promoting employment opportunities and strengthening the state’s grassroots sports infrastructure.

fields.schemeName: State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free residential, food, clothing, and healthcare are provided to destitute elderly individuals above 60 years in state-run residential facilities.

fields.schemeName: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- is provided for the purchase of individual aids, which may be increased to a maximum of ₹7,000/- in special cases. Additionally, ₹500/- is provided for the repair of prosthetic limbs and other assistive equipment.

fields.schemeName: Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to traditional women workers whose primary occupation is handloom weaving, spinning, or related weaving activities. Under this scheme, eligible women workers are provided with handloom equipment, including looms & related equipment, worth upto ₹25,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities. Under this scheme, financial assistance between ₹74,000/- to ₹2,50,000/-is provided.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.

fields.schemeName: Uttarakhand Oon Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote traditional wool spinning and weaving activities in the state while providing sustainable employment opportunities to local artisans and weavers.

fields.schemeName: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the nutrition of dairy animals and enhance milk production by providing subsidized silage and feed to members of milk cooperative societies.

fields.schemeName: Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage milk production and ensure fair remuneration to cattle farmers by providing financial incentives based on the quality of milk supplied to cooperative societies.

fields.schemeName: Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the health and well-being of pregnant women and newborns by providing Ayurvedic-based healthcare services and treatment.

fields.schemeName: Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities.

fields.schemeName: National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates. Under the scheme, the eligible households are entitled to 5 kg of food grains per person per month.

fields.schemeName: Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports & identify grassroots-level talent among youth through structured competitions & training. Players are provided with cash prizes and free training, & participation is encouraged at multiple levels, including Gram Panchayat, Development Block, District, and State.

fields.schemeName: Silkworm Rearing Chamber
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sericulture & enhance silk production among farmers by providing financial assistance for establishing dedicated silkworm rearing chambers. Under this scheme, farmers are provided financial support of upto ₹1,00,000 (80:10:10 pattern) for construction of rearing chambers.

fields.schemeName: Silk Tree Plantation
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mulberry cultivation and silkworm rearing among farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance, technical support, and organized cluster-based sericulture activities to enhance their income and livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Silkworm Rearing Equipment
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support individuals in silkworm rearing by providing necessary equipment, financial assistance, and technical guidance. Under this scheme, financial assistance of upto ₹40,000/- is provided to individuals for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Abhiyaan - Humdard
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to organize special campaigns for senior citizens, mentally and physically challenged individuals, and other destitute people in the state to make them aware of welfare schemes, their legal rights, access to benefits, skill development, personal security & protection, etc.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Institutional Delivery
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote safe and institutional deliveries by providing free accommodation to pregnant women, especially from disaster-prone areas, near district hospitals.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote horticulture development in Uttarakhand by providing farmers with subsidized fruit plants, seeds, pesticides, & horticulture infrastructure such as Cool Houses & Refrigerator Vans, thereby increasing productivity, reducing post-harvest losses, & enhancing farmers’ income.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Existing Assets
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist the units who are in existence for a minimum period of 2 years with good track record. The assistance is provided for purchase of existing land, building and machinery with prescribed residual life. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

fields.schemeName: Dr. S.K. Mukherjee Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture Students (2nd & 3rd Year)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. Agriculture course in their 2nd and 3rd years of study by awarding a one-year scholarship of ₹1,100 per month.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Setting Up of Industrial Estates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist organizations (Public Limited Companies, Private Limited Companies, Partnerships, Sole Proprietary, and Municipalities) for setting up of industrial estates for exclusive allotment of sheds/plots to SSI units. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Purchase of Paddy Harvesting Machine
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme for Purchase of Paddy Harvesting Machine" aims to assist agriculturists belonging to Puducherry for the purchase of a tractor and harvesting machine to harvest the crops in their vicinity. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

fields.schemeName: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of 500 or More Seater Convention Centre as Above cum Hotel under MICE
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost MICE tourism by incentivizing the creation of large convention centers. It provides a 15% capital subsidy up to ₹10,00,00,000/- to investors establishing convention centers with a 500+ seating capacity and a minimum investment of ₹20,00,00,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of Way Side Amenities Under Green Field or Franchise Model
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the tourism experience by subsidizing the development of wayside amenities under Green Field or Franchise models. It offers a 15% capital investment subsidy capped at ₹50,00,000/- to investors who establish approved facilities with a minimum capital expenditure.

fields.schemeName: Capital Investment Subsidy for Creation of Infrastructure
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the creation of essential infrastructure on leased tourism lands. It provides a 25% capital investment subsidy up to ₹3,00,00,000/- to private investors establishing power, water, road, and drainage systems for tourism projects.

fields.schemeName: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free laptops to visually impaired students pursuing courses. The scheme is provisioned for providing laptops to the visually impaired students to pursue professional courses after XII, under-graduate and post-graduate courses.

fields.schemeName: Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: "Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship" is a Scholarship by the Higher Education Department, Govt. of Odisha. The objective of the scheme is the promotion of the Odia Language by way of encouraging meritorious students to take up higher studies in Odia Language at the U.G. and P.G. levels.

fields.schemeName: State Horticulture Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The “State Horticulture Scholarship” is a scholarship scheme, launched by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Nagaland to provide scholarship/stipend to students who are pursuing B.Sc. (Horticulture) M.Sc. (Horticulture) Ph.D. (Horticulture) courses.

fields.schemeName: Sudakshya For Girls Child Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: This scholarship provides financial assistance to all deserving students who want to pursue higher studies.  Under this scholarship scheme, the students fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive a maintenance allowance and other benefits.

fields.schemeName: Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award For Meritorious Children With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award for Meritorious Children with Disabilities” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Scholarship for Sainik Schools
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme Of Scholarship For Sainik Schools" was launched by the Directorate Of Higher and Technical Education, Meghalaya, to prepare young boys for a career in the Cadre of the Armed Forces. The scholarships are awarded to students whose family income is less than ₹8,000/- per month.

fields.schemeName: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching
fields.briefDescription: The award is given to the coaches who have devoted their career to imparting Coaching in any of the major sports disciplines and have coached Sportspersons achieving excellence at National and International levels.

fields.schemeName: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti
fields.briefDescription: Under Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti Madhya Pradesh Government aimed at providing financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to these marginalized communities.

fields.schemeName: Research (PhD) Scholarship for SC/ST Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, offers financial support for PhD research work to SC/ST students. Eligible students receive ₹16,000/- per month, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year, which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.

fields.schemeName: Prathibha Scholarship Programme
fields.briefDescription: Prathibha Scholarship Programme is aimed at motivating bright Students to higher studies in Science by awarding Scholarships. Prathibha Scholars are also provided opportunities to attend Science Orientation Programmes and interact with pioneers in Science through the SPEED Scheme.

fields.schemeName: Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Chief Minister Sarbananda Sonowal launched the Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme at the Srimanta Sankardev International Auditorium on 26 December 2019 in the presence of Finance Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, , several senior officials of the State Finance Department, and bank officials

fields.schemeName: Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme" was launched on 26 December 2019 by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Assam. The scheme is managed by the Finance Department, Govt. of Assam. The govt. will provide a loan subsidy of up to ₹ 50,000 on education loans to students pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Chief Minister Self-Employment Scheme for Drivers/Conductors
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to support self-employment for registered drivers and conductors by providing financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles to eligible beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
fields.briefDescription: The Exposure Visits to the Assam Legislative Assembly scheme was introduced in the budget speech during the first Budget Session in July 2016. It aims to provide an opportunity for Political Science students in Assam to visit and observe the functioning of the Assam Legislative Assembly.

fields.schemeName: Payment Related to Wheat Procurement
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure timely online payment to farmers for wheat sold at government procurement centers through the Just-In-Time (JIT) system directly into their bank accounts.

fields.schemeName: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram Madhya Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free healthcare services to pregnant women and infants up to one year of age, including free treatment, medicines, diet, and transport facilities in government hospitals.

fields.schemeName: Haryana Merit Cum Means Scheme For Minority
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from minority communities in Haryana for pursuing professional and technical courses.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students (Delhi)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students" aims to support SC students financially for post-matriculation studies. Benefits include fee reimbursement and monthly allowances. Intended beneficiaries are SC students with a family income below ₹2,50,000/- annually.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat
fields.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat also referred to as the Assam Tea Garden Workers' Financial Assistance Scheme 2025. This initiative marks the 200th-year celebration of Assam Tea and aims to provide one-time financial assistance to tea garden workers in recognition of their invaluable contribution.
